name: Interlagos / Autódromo José Carlos Pace

demands.interpretation: The published layout description calls for an aerodynamic balance. Compare measured sector and apex-speed differences; straight-line speed alone cannot isolate power or drag.
Pirelli identifies degradation management as a key race factor. Tyre-age trends, temperature and compound must be compared together; physical tyre wear is not measured.
Pirelli reports resurfacing between turns 3–5 and 8–9 for 2026. Rain and temperature swings can change relative pace; wet and slick samples must not be pooled into a car verdict.

note: Published circuit context is not a team-performance prior. No named team receives a bonus from these descriptions. This profile is scoped to 2026; recorded speed zones are estimates, not official corner classifications.
